verdict.rationale: Mastra is a self-hostable framework that can be built and hosted anywhere, so application data such as memory and workflow snapshots sits in storage the user controls. It also documents converting stored messages to AI SDK-compatible formats via `toAISdkMessages()`. However, the evidence shows no dedicated export capability, and data portability is only implied by self-hosting. Missing for 10: documented full-data export tooling, explicit open/standard export formats beyond AI SDK message conversion, coverage of traces/evals/snapshots export, and independent hands-on corroboration of migrating off Mastra.
